26: // Dispenser is a type that dispenses tokens, similarly to a lexer,
27: // except that it can do so with some notion of structure. An empty
28: // Dispenser is invalid; call NewDispenser to make a proper instance.
29: type Dispenser struct {

41: func NewDispenser(tokens []Token) *Dispenser {
42: 	d := &Dispenser{
43: 		tokens: tokens,
44: 		cursor: -1,

61: // was loaded; false otherwise. If false, all tokens
62: // have been consumed.

65: 		d.cursor++
66: 		d.cursor += d.captureTokenContext()

73: // of Next(), except this function may decrement the cursor
74: // to -1 so that the next call to Next() points to the
75: // first token; this allows dispensing to "start over". This
76: // method returns true if the cursor ends up pointing to a
77: // valid token.

79: 	if d.cursor > -1 {
80: 		d.cursor--

97: 	}

112: 	}

153: // block will be consumed internally and omitted from
154: // the iteration.

159: //	}
